readout_other: mNSS; balance beam test; brain water content; western blot, qRT-PCR, immunofluorescence and immunohistochemistry for OX-A, OXR1, NF-kB, NLRP3, TNF-a, IL-1b, IL-18; H&E and Nissl staining
direction_notes: LIFUS to the hypothalamus after TBI reduced tissue damage, brain water content, neurological deficit scores and pro-inflammatory cytokines, and increased OX-A and OXR1; the OXR1 antagonist SB334867 reversed the anti-inflammatory effect. No neural activity was measured.

exposures.label: LIFUS to the hypothalamus after traumatic brain injury

timing.protocol_description: Fundamental frequency stated as 500 Hz, on-break ratio 5 %, PRF 250 Hz, total ultrasonic duration 400 ms. Each rat was stimulated for 30 min a day for three consecutive days, starting 20 min after TBI.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The rats were randomly divided into four groups: sham operation with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) (sham group, n=30, 268.5±10.7 g), TBI with DMSO and sham LIFUS (TBI group, n=30, 266.4±12.3 g), TBI with DMSO and LIFUS (TBI+LIFUS group, n=30, 271.5±11.7 g), and TBI with SB334867, DMSO, and LIFUS (TBI+LIFUS+SB334867 group, n=12, 267.9±12.8 g).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each rat was stimulated for 30 min in a day for three consecutive days.

flags.reason: Text says 'set to 500 Hz' but the same sentence cites a 440 to 700 KHz skull-penetration range, so kHz was probably meant. Recorded as stated (0.5 kHz).
Pulse duration not stated; DC/PRF would give 0.2 ms but it is not computed here.
Duty cycle is called an 'on-break ratio'; 400 ms is the 'total ultrasonic duration' of one sonication, repeated for 30 min a day; the nested structure is not fully described.
Only group sizes are stated (sham 30, TBI 30, TBI+LIFUS 30, TBI+LIFUS+SB334867 12); only the last two groups received active ultrasound; per-assay n is 6.
TBI induced and drug injected under ether anaesthesia; the anaesthetic state during LIFUS is not stated explicitly.
Only the neurobehavioural testers are stated to be blinded.
Reported as 518 mW/cm2 in degassed water; recorded as 0.518 W/cm2. Hydrophone-measured through no skull.
Sham LIFUS: probe placed on head without starting the machine; a separate sham-operation group also exists.
